title: Why is "Battery Optimization prompt" not set by default?
symptom: The setting 'Battery Optimization prompt' is unchecked by default, and the user questions why it is not enabled by default to prompt disabling battery optimization for xDrip.
cause: The setting's behavior is inverted: when set, it actually disables the prompt, so the default (unchecked) is correct.
fix: No code change needed; the default is correct. However, it was suggested to rename the setting to something like 'No Bat opt Prompt' to better reflect its behavior.
evidence_quote: Even though the title of the setting is "Battery optimization prompt", but if you set it, it will actually disable prompting you! So, the default, being disabled, is what it should be.
